result.reason: The redline appropriately adds professional/workmanlike performance, material conformance to documentation, a no-malicious-code warranty, remedies, and a carveout from the disclaimer. However, it does not include any warranty duration, failing both the preferred periods (12 months for software and 90 days for services) and fallback periods (90 days and 30 days). It also omits the required compliance-with-laws warranty, and limits the services warranty to “Technical Support Services,” which may be narrower than the covered Services. The remedy formulation is somewhat unclear because “fees paid for the non-conforming period” may not provide a meaningful refund for licensed technology.
